newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz to offer creditors 3.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz to offer creditors 3.1 mln shares.

text.p: Polish furniture company Swarzedz SA wants to earmark 3,125,000 shares of its new share issue of up to 6,625,000 shares for a debt-for-equity scheme, the firm said in a statement on Friday.
Swarzedz said 3.5 million of the shares would be earmarked for current shareholders with one existing share held entitling them to take one share of the new issue.
The new issue must be approved by an extraordinary shareholders meeting on February 8.
Swarzedz made a net loss of 38.6 million zlotys last year.
The company has said its creditors would decide on a general debt restructuring plan for the firm in the next few weeks.
Swarzedz currently has 3.5 million shares outstanding.
